msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia venus-lenceria-jerez-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a deep red lace underwired bra laid on a soft burgundy knit blanket with a few autumn leaves from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia venus-lenceria-jerez-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a deep red lace underwired bra (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia venus-lenceria-jerez-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a nude seamless moulded t-shirt bra (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia venus-lenceria-jerez-18.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a black microfibre high-waist brief with a wide pink waistband (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia venus-lenceria-jerez-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a cream satin long pyjama set with a brown animal print, folded on a hanger (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
